Minor bug fixes and 

* Fixed handling of non-case-sensitive matching of categorical variable levels in observation data. If a user has defined the accepted levels of the `fruitColor` trait as `Red` and `Blue` but uploaded observation data with `red` and `blue`, these will be automatically case-corrected to the defined values by default. This behavior can be disabled.
* Added handling of string NA values (`NA`, `na`, `Na`, `N/A`, and `n/a`) in numerical columns of retrieved observation datasets.
* Added `message()` to note how many observation variables were present in a retrieved observations dataset.
* Standardized how arguments are described in function docstrings.
* Added a logo.
